licensing.basis: Scottish STL licensing: scheme operational 1 Oct 2022; existing hosts had until 1 Oct 2023

secondaryLetLicenceFee.basis: Edinburgh STL licence fee, secondary letting

certification.basis: Tourism NI: all tourist accommodation must hold a current certificate; inspection every 4 years; fee GBP 40 per unit (min 40, max 350)

penalty.unit: maximum fine (or up to 6 months' imprisonment)
penalty.basis: Tourism (Northern Ireland) Order 1992 penalty for operating uncertified

hotelRoomOccupancyTax.unit: percent plus USD 2.00 per room per night (rent $40+)
hotelRoomOccupancyTax.basis: NYC hotel room occupancy tax; permanent residents (180+ days) exempt
hotelRoomOccupancyTax.note: The flat per-night tiers are on the primary page; the 5.875% rate is from secondary sources. Plus 8.875% sales tax and a $1.50/unit state hotel fee (secondary).

roomOccupancyTax.basis: Connecticut room occupancy tax on hotels and lodging houses, stays of 30 days or less (B&Bs 11%)

transientOccupancyTax.basis: LA TOT (LAMC s.21.7) on hotels and short-term rentals of 30 days or fewer
transientOccupancyTax.note: Rate from search snippets of finance.lacity.gov; not read on the page.

accommodationTax.basis: No tourist or occupancy tax in London; VAT 20% applies only if the host is VAT-registered (threshold GBP 90,000)

vatAccommodation.basis: Irish VAT on guest and holiday accommodation stays at 13.5%; the 1 Jul 2026 cut to 9% covers food/catering only; applies only if host is VAT-registered
vatAccommodation.note: Confirmed via multiple advisers' summaries of Revenue guidance; Revenue manual not read directly.

municipalAccommodationTax.basis: Toronto MAT on rentals under 28 consecutive days

hst.basis: Ontario HST, where the host is registered

pst.basis: BC PST on short-term accommodation; exempt for continuous stays of 27+ days

majorEventsMrdt.basis: Vancouver Major Events MRDT, 1 Feb 2023 to 31 Jan 2030

gst.basis: Federal GST where the host is registered (applies on provincial taxes too)

impuestoSobreHospedaje.basis: CDMX Codigo Fiscal: ISH 3.5% general and 5% for lodging via digital platforms in 2026

iva.basis: Ley del IVA art. 1; platforms withhold 50% of IVA from registered individual hosts (art. 18-J, 100% if no RFC)
iva.note: diputados.gob.mx PDF shows last reform DOF 12-11-2021.

isrWithholdingLodging.basis: LISR art. 113-A ISR withholding on lodging income via platforms, 2026

visitorLevy.basis: Edinburgh Visitor Levy from 24 Jul 2026 on all paid overnight accommodation incl. short-term lets; bookings made from 1 Oct 2025; charged on pre-VAT price

accommodationTax.basis: No tourist tax in Northern Ireland; VAT 20% only if host is VAT-registered
accommodationTax.note: Absence of a levy inferred; no NI levy found.

uncertain: No rental company publishes an airport rate card; every daily base rate is a Kayak average with no date on the page, and the Mexico City figures show only '$' (MXN is inferred).
AirDNA figures come from search-engine snippets because the site blocks fetching; they cover all listing types, not entire homes only, and the currency (USD) is assumed.
New York City's AirDNA ADR describes a market where entire-home stays under 30 nights are illegal, so it reflects hosted rooms and 30-plus-night stays rather than holiday lets.
Enterprise's New York young-renter fees differ between enterprise.com ($68.75 and $33.25) and enterprise.co.uk ($64.75 and $30.75); both are Enterprise's own pages.

Hertz US and Canada young-driver fee amounts, CDW/LDW daily prices at every non-Mexican location, one-way fees and airport concession rates are not published; Hertz shows them only in a booking quote.
The LAX customer facility charge of $12/day from 1 Jan 2026, the 11.11% concession recovery and the 3.5% California tourism assessment are from secondary sources.
The New York MCTD special supplemental tax on car rentals is 6% in the statute, not the 5% named in the brief.
BC PST on an economy rental car is 7% under PST 116, not 8%; 8% is the accommodation rate.
Los Angeles sales tax rises from 9.75% to 10.25% on 1 Oct 2026, two days after retrieval.
Mexico City's 5% platform lodging tax and the enforceability of the 50% occupancy cap (suspended by court orders for many hosts) are from secondary sources.
Ireland's rules for US visitors conflict: Citizens Information says an IDP is needed, while the US Embassy says US citizens may drive up to 12 months as tourists.
No Mexican government source was found on whether tourists' foreign licences are valid; only rental companies' terms.
Vrbo's cancellation tiers and host fees are from compilers because Vrbo's help article returned an error page, and Vrbo publishes no percentage for its traveler service fee.
New Haven has no short-term rental ordinance recorded here; it was not researched in a primary source.
Current Europcar UK young-driver surcharge and refueling charges are known only from a 2022 tariff guide.
